Metro Time Helper: Taipei MRT

Privacy Policy

Metro Time Helper does not collect personal data. This page explains what the app does on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android phone and what it never does.

Last Updated: 2026-10-29

Our commitments

  • No account

    No account is required. You never sign up, sign in, or give us your name, email address, or phone number to use the app.

  • Data we collect

    We do not collect personal data. The app does not access your location, contacts, photos, or any identifier for tracking, and it does not send the stations or times you enter to us or anyone else.

  • Everything stays on your devices

    All trip calculations run on your device using timetable data built into the app. Your settings, such as stations, language, colours, launch page, and reminders, are stored only on your device. Deleting the app removes them.

  • Widgets, Live Activities, and Apple Watch

    The app also runs on iPad and Apple Watch, with a Home Screen and Lock Screen widget, a widget for the Apple Watch face, and, on iPhone, a Live Activity that counts down to your reminder on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. So that a widget can show the same trip as the app, the app and its own widgets share your latest trip (stations and times) through Apple's Keychain Sharing; this happens only on the same device, and nothing is uploaded to any server. Live Activities are created and updated only on the device, with no server sending updates to them, and deleting the app removes all of this.

  • Android version (Google Play)

    Metro Time Helper is also offered for Android through Google Play, and everything on this page applies to it as well. The Android version does not collect or transmit personal data, shows no ads, and uses no analytics. Your settings and reminders are stored only on your device. Payment is handled by Google Play, and the app never sees your payment details. The Internet permission is used only to download the official timetable PDF from Taipei Metro's website when you tap to open it. The app also asks for notifications, used only for the departure reminders you set and which you may decline; and for the boot-completed broadcast, so that your reminders are scheduled again after the phone restarts. The home screen widgets for the next train on the Xiaobitan and Beitou · Xinbeitou branches use only the timetable data inside the app.

    Android version: Google Play

  • Notifications

    If you allow notifications, the app uses them only for reminders you set yourself. Every reminder is scheduled locally on your device; no server is involved and no notification content leaves your device. You can turn notifications off at any time in the iOS Settings app.

  • No ads, no analytics, no tracking

    We do not use third-party advertising. We do not use third-party analytics. The app contains no tracking code and does not link data to you or share it with data brokers.

  • Timetable data

    Timetables, headways, and run times come from Taipei Metro's official public data and are included in the app itself, so looking up a trip does not require an internet connection. The exceptions are the official timetable PDF and the official network map (the vector map published by Taipei Metro, in Chinese or English): each is downloaded from Taipei Metro's website only when you tap its button, as an ordinary web request, and we receive nothing about it. This app is independently developed and is not affiliated with the operator of the Taipei Metro. Unofficial.

  • Questions and your rights

    Because we hold no personal data about you, there is nothing for us to access, export, or delete. If you email us, we use your message only to reply and do not add you to any mailing list. Write to the address below with any privacy question.

  • Changes to this policy

    If the way the app handles data ever changes, we will update this page and the Last Updated date before the change takes effect, and explain the change in the app's release notes.

Contact us

Questions, a timetable that looks wrong, or an idea for the app? Write to us. Mentioning your phone model, iOS or Android version, the app version (shown in Settings), and the stations involved helps us look into it faster.

Email hourstag.app@gmail.com
